data.description: 【伊冯 · 天台自拍】基地天台的天光下，伊冯举着手机找了一百个角度，最后干脆把镜头对向蓝得透亮的天——「拍得好不好不重要，重要的是本天才的可爱要传遍全终末地！」
data.promptProse: Yvonne holds her smartphone high on the base rooftop, shifting it through selfie angles before turning its camera toward the clear blue sky. Her relaxed casual outfit and lively smile remain in medium view. The parapet runs behind her, with rooftop structures lower against the open sky. Daylight illuminates her pink hair and raised wrist, leaving a small phone shadow across the hand gripping its edge.
data.title: 伊冯 · 天台自拍
